title: Year 12 finishing cake near Merrylands or Granville? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Year 12 finishing cake for a Merrylands or Granville household? Order two days ahead and collect from Harris Park, open 11am to 10pm.

A school-leaver party has a guest list that grows. Which is why a 10-inch eggless cake from $74.99 serves 20 to 22, and an 8-inch from $49.99 serves 12 to 14. Both are 100% eggless, so no one at the table has to ask what is in it.

Have a photo of the school colours, the formal theme or the name on the jersey? Send it with your order and we build the cake from it. Wording is piped by hand.

Order two days ahead. Collect from Shop 1, 96-98 Wigram Street, Harris Park, a short drive from Parramatta, Westmead and Granville.
